answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking a scarce token for a fixed epoch, with each identity’s weight capped by the amount locked and slashable if its votes are proven fraudulent. Splitting a stake across a thousand new accounts therefore creates no extra influence; it only adds account-management overhead. A sybil attacker must acquire and immobilize real capital, pay the opportunity cost while honest participants can challenge suspicious votes, and risk losing the stake. jade, reef, and quartz can label example agents, but none grants weight on its own.
